correctness.rationale: Homogeneity and the generic extension property identify complete nonalgebraic types with admissible cuts: L a lower ideal, U an upper filter, and L×U contained in the strict order. These conditions are sufficient by transitivity, and placing one new point below a second is consistent exactly with growing L and shrinking U. In D(P), q⁰<p¹ for p not strictly below q is stable under composing either within-copy relation; no return cross-arrows are allowed. Its ideal consisting of P\U in copy 0 and L in copy 1 is therefore exactly the corresponding cut. Every cover of ideals adds one point, proving the stated rank and grading. Independent review-work/census.py posets 7 enumerates all naturally labeled orders without early isomorphism pruning (96,428 at seven), by adding a maximal point over an ideal; any poset admits a topological labeling. Exact degree-group permutations quotient each invariant fiber. As a separate type-count route, exhaustive three-color assignments on each representative use antitone colors 2,1,0 across comparable pairs and forbid incomparable pairs colored 2 and 0, tallying the rank as their sum. It recovered 1,1,2,5,16,63,318,2045 classes at orders zero to seven, injectivity through six, 2,039 ranks at seven with precisely six doubletons and 2,045 distinct bivariate profiles. The complete six cover-pair certificates were matched via transitive closure and exact isomorphism; the displayed first rank vector sums to 68. See review-work/posets.txt. There is no inference about larger orders or equality of full type lattices.
